title: 第一卷 第7章 除了冲您来的还能有谁第一卷 第8章 谁给你的自信觉得我看上你了
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 三天时间转瞬即逝。
天斗帝国，元素谷。
十八辆通体由玄铁打造的重型马车，排成一列长长的车队，压得谷外的主干道嘎吱作响。
每一辆马车周围，都跟着四名全副武装的魂王级护卫。
打头的马车最为宽敞豪华。
车厢里铺满柔软的纯白虎皮，宁天整个人四仰八叉地躺在上面，脑袋舒舒服服地枕着随行侍女的大腿，时不时张开嘴，接过侍女剥好送来的冰镇葡萄。
“这破路也太颠了，差点把本少爷早饭晃出来。”
宁天嚼着葡萄，含糊不清地抱怨。
“少爷忍忍，已经到谷口了。”
侍女赶紧放轻动作，小心翼翼地帮他揉捏肩膀。
车厢外，宁风致穿着一身暗金线绣花的月白长袍，骑在最前方的高头大马上。
他左侧稍落后半个身位，是白衣胜雪的剑斗罗尘心。
古榕留守宗门镇场子，这次提亲，由他们两人带队。
马蹄声在谷口宽阔的青石广场上停下。
偌大的元素谷正门，此刻静悄悄的。
别说红毯和迎接的管事，连两扇镶满铜钉的朱红大门都紧紧闭着。
大门两侧的石狮子底下，只站着两个穿着杂役服饰的看门守卫，正靠在石柱上有一搭没一搭地聊天。
看到这浩浩荡荡的车队停下，两名守卫对视一眼，连腰都没直起来。
左边那个瘦高个守卫懒洋洋地打了个哈欠，单手拎着长枪走上前。
“站住！
今天元素谷不接客，哪来的回哪去。”
瘦高个守卫甚至没正眼看宁风致，语气极其嚣张。
“放肆！”
随行的一名七宝琉璃宗外门长老冷喝一声。
“瞎了你的狗眼，没看到这是七宝琉璃宗的车队？去叫你们四大家族的族长出来迎接！”
“七宝琉璃宗？”
瘦高个守卫掏了掏耳朵，毫不客气地嗤笑出声。
“七宝琉璃宗怎么了？还当自己是在天斗城呢？”
他伸出手指，指着后面那辆豪华马车。
“别说七宝琉璃宗，就算是天王老子来了，只要是带了那个没法修炼的废物来，一律不见！
“我们元素谷，可不收留连十级魂力都突破不了的窝囊废！”
这话一出，全场空气瞬间凝固。
坐在马车里的宁天挑了挑眉，翻了个身继续躺着。
“这元素谷的人，头真铁啊。”
“爹，这人家连门都不给进，咱是不是可以打道回府了？”
宁风致没有回头，他依然端坐在马背上，只是一声轻笑传了出来。
“赵长老。”
宁风致语气很平淡。
刚才出声喝斥的那位外门长老大步迈出。
“大少爷今天有喜事在身，我听不得这种不会说话的狗叫。”
宁风致轻轻理了理袖口。
“属下明白！”
赵长老猛地抬起头，脚下黄、黄、紫、紫、黑、黑、黑七个魂环瞬间炸开。
content_en:
Three days passed in a blink of an eye.
Tiandou Empire, Elemental Valley.
Eighteen heavy-duty carriages made entirely of dark iron lined up in a long convoy, making the main road outside the valley creak.
Each carriage was surrounded by four fully armed soul king-level guards.
The first carriage is the most spacious and luxurious.
The carriage was covered with soft pure white tiger skin, and Ning Tian lay sprawled on it, his head resting comfortably on the thigh of the accompanying maid. From time to time, he opened his mouth and took the iced grapes that the maid had peeled and brought.
"This broken road is too bumpy. It almost knocked my young master out of his breakfast."
Ning Tian chewed the grapes and complained vaguely.
"Master Renren, we have arrived at the mouth of the valley."
The maid quickly moved gently and carefully rubbed his shoulders.
Outside the carriage, Ning Fengzhi was wearing a moon-white robe embroidered with dark gold threads, riding on a tall horse at the front.
Slightly half a body behind him on the left side is the sword fight Luo Chenxin, who is dressed in white and Shengxue.
Gu Rong stayed behind in the sect town, and they were the two of them to lead the marriage proposal this time.
The sound of horse hooves stopped in the wide bluestone square at the entrance of the valley.
The main entrance of the huge Elemental Valley was quiet at the moment.
Not to mention the red carpet and the stewards who greeted her, even the two vermilion doors studded with copper nails were tightly closed.
Under the stone lions on both sides of the gate, there were only two gatekeepers in handymen's clothes standing, leaning against the stone pillars and chatting.
Seeing the mighty motorcade stop, the two guards looked at each other without even straightening up.
The tall and thin guard on the left yawned lazily and stepped forward with a spear in one hand.
"Stop!
The Elemental Valley is not accepting guests today, so those who came will go back where they came from. "
The tall and thin guard didn't even look at Ning Fengzhi, and his tone was extremely arrogant.
"Presumptuous!"
One of the accompanying elders from the outer sect of Qibao Glazed Sect gave a cold shout.
"Are you so blind that you didn't see that this is the convoy of the Qibao Glazed Sect? Go and ask the heads of the four major families of yours to come out to greet us!"
"Seven Treasures Glazed Sect?"
The tall and thin guard plucked his ears and sneered unceremoniously.
"What happened to the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect? Do you still think you are in Tiandou City?"
He stretched out his finger and pointed at the luxury carriage behind him.
"Don't talk about the Qibao Glazed Sect, even if I, the Heavenly King, come, as long as I bring that trash who can't practice, he will not be seen!
"We in the Elemental Valley will not accept losers who can't even break through the tenth level of soul power! "
As soon as these words came out, the air in the whole place instantly froze.
Ning Tian, who was sitting in the carriage, raised his eyebrows, turned over and continued to lie down.
“The people from Elemental Valley are really hard-headed. "
“Dad, this guy doesn’t even let you in, can we go back home? "
Ning Fengzhi didn't look back. He was still sitting on the horse and just let out a chuckle.
"Elder Zhao. "
Ning Fengzhi's tone was very calm.
"Here! "
The outer elder who had just scolded him strode forward.
"The eldest young master has a happy event today, and I can't bear to hear the barking of such a mute dog. "
Ning Fengzhi gently straightened her sleeves.
"My subordinate understands! "
Elder Zhao suddenly raised his head, and the seven soul rings of yellow, yellow, purple, purple, black, black and black exploded instantly under his feet.
